description: PRESS RELEASE TERRY WATERS ANNOUNCES CANDIDACY FOR ALABAMA STATE SENATE, DISTRICT 22 ROBERTSDALE, AL — Alabama farmer, veteran, and small business owner Terry Waters announces his candidacy for Alabama State Senate, District 22. Waters is a lifelong resident of the Robertsdale area and has deep roots across the district he hopes to represent.
